10.old: Most detached lots are RF/RF-13/RF-10 (now being folded into the R-zones of the new Surrey Zoning Bylaw), and Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit housing allows up to 3-4 units on many lots.
10.new: Zoning on most detached lots is RF/RF-13/RF-10, a set now moving into the R-zones of Surrey's new Zoning Bylaw, while many lots can also carry up to 3-4 units thanks to Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit housing.

16.old: SkyTrain Expo Line (King George to Scott Road), the coming Surrey Langley SkyTrain along Fraser Hwy, and RapidBus R1/R6.
16.new: The Surrey Langley SkyTrain is coming along Fraser Hwy, adding to the SkyTrain Expo Line between King George and Scott Road and the RapidBus R1/R6 routes.

23.old: The main pockets are Cloverdale, Fleetwood, Guildford, Newton, Panorama Ridge, Sullivan Heights, Clayton and South Surrey. Each has a different mix of lot sizes, age of homes and price points, so I match the area to your budget and commute.
23.new: The main areas to look at are Guildford, Fleetwood, Cloverdale, Clayton, Newton, South Surrey, Panorama Ridge and Sullivan Heights. Each differs in lot sizes, the age of its homes and prices, and that is why I line the area up with your budget and commute.

25.old: Homes here are in Surrey School District 36. Catchments are set by address, so confirm the specific school with the district before you buy.
25.new: Surrey School District 36 covers the homes in this area. The address decides the catchment, so ask the district to confirm the specific school before you purchase.

27.old: Options include SkyTrain Expo Line (King George to Scott Road), the coming Surrey Langley SkyTrain along Fraser Hwy, and RapidBus R1/R6.
27.new: Transit choices are the RapidBus R1/R6 lines, plus the Surrey Langley SkyTrain, which is coming along Fraser Hwy, and SkyTrain on the Expo Line (King George to Scott Road).

29.old: Most detached lots are RF/RF-13/RF-10 (now being folded into the R-zones of the new Surrey Zoning Bylaw), and Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit housing allows up to 3-4 units on many lots.
29.new: Many lots can now hold up to 3-4 units under Bill 44 small-scale multi-unit housing. As for detached lots, most are RF/RF-13/RF-10, which Surrey is folding into R-zones under its new Zoning Bylaw.

33.old: Yes, qualifying buyers can use the BC First-Time Home Buyers' property transfer tax exemption and the federal FHSA. See my first-time buyer guide for current thresholds.
33.new: Yes. A buyer who qualifies can take the federal FHSA and the First-Time Home Buyers' exemption from BC property transfer tax too; the current thresholds are laid out in my first-time buyer guide.
